# zerocake.org — Monzero: plain guides to Monero for readers starting from zero

> Independent guides to Monero for someone who has never used it: what it is, how it works and where to begin. Written in English. Every figure names where it came from.

How this site works, in three rules:

- **Every figure names where it came from.** A figure, a date or a version number is the publishing project's, and the guide says which and when it was checked.
- **No price talk, no promise of returns.** The guides explain how Monero works and how to use it, not whether to buy it.
- **Nothing here is paid for.** No project, exchange or company pays to be mentioned, ranked or linked.

## What a reader finds here

- [Guides](https://zerocake.org/guides/): every Monzero guide, newest first.
- [About](https://zerocake.org/about/): the rules above, written out at length.
- [Everything in one file](https://zerocake.org/llms-full.txt): every page as Markdown. Each page is also at its own address with `.md` appended.

## Where the figures come from

The Monero project's own documentation and source code, and the organisations that publish the figures a guide cites. Each guide names its source and the date it was checked.
